visual_defects: viewing v03 against the reference at 1:1 showed the reference sets a markedly heavier weight on the selected nav label, the three KPI labels, the three KPI change values, the three activity item titles, the four table column headers, the three table project names and the three status pill runs; the first version set all of them regular. This was seen with the image tool first and only afterwards quantified (stroke-mass ratios 1.40-1.92 on those 17 elements)
defects_found_by_measurement_not_by_eye: the selected nav pill was 182x46 at (19,117) against the reference 184x48 at (18,116) - a real 2px error on two axes, too small to see reliably at 1:1 but caught by the geometric anchor probe
KPI labels were still 5-6% light and the activity titles had overshot to 10% heavy after the first weight pass, caught by the stroke-mass probe
self_defects_in_generator: a Card(...) helper call used as an element of a comma-separated array literal failed with `Missing expression after ','`; had to be inlined
a duplicated half-written AddT block blocked emission until collapsed to one definition
-ResetOnly was declared but the snapshot write was not guarded, so the switch still wrote a file

an inline `powershell -Command` launched from the shell wrapper had its $e / $PL / $o expanded by the outer shell, so the reset silently did nothing; fixed by deleting placement.json before running -ResetOnly as a file
self_defects_in_measurer: compare.ps1 computed the probe window right edge as rx + padR instead of rx + rw + padR, clipping every ink box and producing nonsense font-size corrections; three passes against v01 were discarded as invalid before the reset was done properly

probe-anchors.ps1 returned 0 anchors while reporting success: `measure` is a built-in PowerShell alias for Measure-Object and aliases outrank script functions, so `Measure $ref` never ran the script function; renamed to MeasureAnchors
iterations.harness_image_channel_defect: the image channel can re-serve stale frames; every opening in this task was content-matched against the file being opened (the v03/v06/v07 opens all showed the expected dashboards, and the thumbnail and four crops each showed exactly their own region). No unique-path copies and no independent QA agent were needed for A15 because no mismatch was observed

summary: A15 reconstructed the 1440x900 reference dashboard from inputs/content.json with a 36-rectangle / 59-text DSL built entirely from measurements taken off the reference, which was only ever observed and never cropped, traced or embedded. Seven reference measurement probes, seven DSL versions and six render rounds were needed. The single defect found by actually opening the images was font weight - the reference sets bold on the selected nav label, KPI labels and changes, activity titles, table headers, project names and pill text, which the first version set regular; two further defects (a 2px-small nav pill and a 5-6% light KPI label) were caught by the geometric and stroke-mass probes. Three measurement bugs were fixed along the way, including a clipped probe window and a built-in `measure` alias that silently shadowed the script function. Final state: 44/44 geometry anchors within 1px, 59/59 text anchors within 3px with dx=dy=0 everywhere, 45 elements pixel-identical by stroke mass, all 15 required anchors across four quadrants plus chart and table passing. 8 requests (6 render + 2 document, all HTTP 200, 0 failed, 0 retried), 25933.3 ms of request time, 15 iteration rows, 10 image views across original size, thumbnail and four local crops.
